title: Use central design tokens instead of ad-hoc visual values
statement: Use the central design-token scale for spacing, color, typography, radii, shadows, and control geometry. Do not introduce local hard-coded visual values when a shared token expresses the intent.
rationale: Agent Studio and Quality Studio must retain visual kinship across themes. Ad-hoc pixels and colors silently fork the design language and make systematic refinement expensive.

history.change: Initial default-on rule covering the operator-observed ad-hoc styling defect class.
